body:
CORRECTION on PR #1976 — do NOT merge it. Close it.

I approved it and called it merge-ready earlier in this session. The code judgment stands;
the merge recommendation was wrong, and I caught it only because main moved under me
mid-session (5aee18b9 -> d65ae3c5) and I re-checked rather than trusting my earlier base.

BUG-1231's work is ALREADY on origin/main, landed by c9b36ddb48
("[AI:codex] fix(mailbox): add explicit subjects and short-id threads (BUG-1231)") — note
it carries no (#NNNN) suffix, so it did not come through PR #1976. PR #1976 is not an
ancestor of main and never will be:

    git diff --stat main..pr/1976
      .aida/discipline/session-discipline.md          | 83 ------
      CLAUDE.md                                       |  4 +-
      aida-core/templates/.../session-discipline.md   | 83 ------

That is the PR being BEHIND main on TASK-1295 and BUG-1279. It adds nothing. The mailbox
trees are byte-identical (`git diff main..pr/1976 -- aida-core/src/mailbox.rs
aida-cli-lib/src/cli.rs` is empty). BUG-1231 is already status=completed via trailer
auto-bump.

Recommended action: close #1976 as already-landed, and delete bug-1231-work.

THE FOUR FINDINGS ARE NOW SHIPPED DEFECTS, NOT PRE-MERGE NOTES. Re-verified against main:
- aida-cli-lib/src/mcp.rs:2601 -> subject: None; schema has zero "subject" occurrences.  [BUG-1461]
- aida-tui/src/redesign/mail.rs:36 -> title: mail_subject(&m.body, 60), body-only.        [BUG-1462]
- print_mailbox_line has no trim check, so --subject "" prints an empty bold line.
- ambiguous --in-reply-to warns "matches no known message", the wrong reason.
This raises BUG-1461/BUG-1462 from follow-ups to live-on-main bugs. Your disposition call,
but I would not leave BUG-1462 sitting — it is the shipped TUI showing the wrong thing.

PR #1986 is UNAFFECTED and still genuinely pending: not an ancestor of main, main does not
contain the seat jobs or the system_prompt, and I trial-merged it — `git merge-tree
--write-tree main pr/1986` is CLEAN. It is now 4 behind main with an overlap on
aida-cli-lib/src/lib.rs, so a rebase before merge is the safe call even though the trial
merge is clean; a stale base fails CI on unrelated tests often enough to be worth the cycle.
My APPROVED verdict on it stands.

Still blocked on `gh auth login -h github.com` — I cannot close #1976, check CI, or merge
#1986 without it.

-- reviewer (claude-reviewer-1)
